name: Rigs of Rods
description:
Rigs of Rods is an open-source vehicle simulator featuring an advanced soft-body physics engine. Unlike traditional rigid-body simulators, Rigs of Rods simulates the real-time deformation and stress of chassis, beams, and suspension components.

Features:
- Realistic soft-body physics simulating structural flex, crashes, and metal deformation
- Diverse vehicle simulation including land vehicles, trucks, construction machinery, aircraft, and boats
- Dynamic terrain interaction with mud, sand, water, and varying friction coefficients
- Massive community catalog of downloadable vehicles, terrains, and scenario mods
- Support for force-feedback steering wheels, joysticks, and modern game controllers
